Name: Flower Dance Boys (Edit for 1oxnes and talkohlooeys' Seasonal Portraits)
Author: comfemshep
Description:
I edited the Portraits and Sprites for all the Bachelors to be more colourful instead of just the standard blue. They also now all have flowers incorporated into their Outfits somehow.

[b]Installation[/b]
As long as you already have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30727]oxnes and talkohlooeys' Seasonal Portraits Unofficial 1.6 Update[/url] installed and working you just need to download this mod and drop the [CP] Seasonal Cute Characters and Portraiture files into your mod folder. Let it overwrite the files it wants to.
